focus_areas: Legibility and structure of the signage text.
Geometric consistency and texture sharpness of the mosaic facade tiles.
Boundary sharpness and grounding of the person against the background and sidewalk.
custom_prompts_for_reflector: Pay close attention to the text on the blue sign; AI often fails to render coherent text in stylized fonts. Also, examine the mosaic tiles for 'smearing' or lack of individual tile definition. Verify if the person's feet are properly grounded or if they merge with the sidewalk using depth cues.
image_description: A street-level view of a bakery storefront featuring large glass display windows filled with various baked goods. The facade has a decorative, colorful tiled or mosaic upper section and a blue sign with stylized text above the windows. A person wearing a yellow shirt and blue jeans stands to the right, partially obscuring a mural or poster on the wall. The interior is visible through the glass, showing shelves stocked with breads and pastries under warm lighting.
